title: Add Elements to ArrayList at Specific Index.

blocks.content: Add Elements to ArrayList at Specific Index.
Create a program to add elements to ArrayList at specific index.

items: Inside the main() method, declare a new string ArrayList called movies.
Add strings Avatar and Catch me if you can to movies using the add() function.
Add the string Batman between Avatar and Catch me if you can.

blocks.content:
Expected Output[Avatar, Catch me if you can]
[Avatar, Batman, Catch me if you can]
